readback.format: A2B10G10R10 packed guest scanout; little-endian host words

decoded_png.decoder: Python standard library; unpacked R=bits 0..9, G=10..19, B=20..29, scaled 10-bit channels to 8-bit RGB
decoded_png.visual_observation: A small right-side list-shaped panel has color; the rest of the frame is black. Text and screen identity are not established.

runtime_observations.termination: The harness sent SIGINT, waited eight seconds, then used SIGKILL because the runtime had not exited.
supported: The exact retail XEX ran with this matched Linux runtime and GPU-plugin trio through frame 400.
The harness emitted Start and A events through a Linux uinput gamepad.
The captured frame contains a non-black, list-shaped region.
not_proven: That this run's guest XamInputGetState returned the injected button states.
That the panel is the retail main menu or that Start/A caused it to appear.
